title: Azure Database Services
description: Explore Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB, Redis Cache, and Database Migration Service. Learn multi-model databases and global distribution.
longDescription: This module covers Azure's core database offerings: Azure SQL Database for relational data, Cosmos DB for globally distributed multi-model data, Azure Cache for Redis for high-performance caching, and Azure Database Migration Service for moving workloads to the cloud.
whatYouLearn: Provision Azure SQL Database with serverless, elastic pools, and hyperscale options
Choose the right Cosmos DB API and consistency level for your workload
Use Azure Cache for Redis to speed up application performance
Plan and execute database migrations with Azure Database Migration Service
